audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text and wants.foe[1] both call Yuumi's Q 'You and Me! (Q)' — You and Me! is her W (attach/dash), and Q is actually Prowling Projectile. wants.foe[2] calls Zoomies her 'W' when it's her E.
audit.why: enemyAbilities/enemyKit give Q=Prowling Projectile, W=You and Me!, E=Zoomies. The current text swaps W's ability name onto the Q slot and mislabels E as W, which misdirects a reader tracking cooldowns by slot.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text and wants.foe[1] now say Prowling Projectile (Q); wants.foe[2] now says Zoomies (E).

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t and report[9].t use 'his'/'him' for Yuumi, who is female.
audit.why: Yuumi is on the female-champion list in the lane brief; lintFindings flags both instances as MISGENDER.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit (lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), even though You and Me! having a 0-second cooldown is the single most important number in this matchup.
audit.why: Yuumi's W (You and Me!) has cd 0 per the kit — she can re-attach the instant she detaches, so this matchup is won by tracking her attachment state, not a cooldown timer. That's worth stating explicitly instead of leaving the field generic.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now states the 0-second W cooldown directly.

edits.before: This is a dream lane: while Yuumi is unattached and walking up to poke with You and Me! (Q), she is a soft, immobile 500-HP target. Reach level 2 first and Rocket Grab (Q) her out of position; her only safety is attaching to her ADC, so punish every second she's detached.
edits.after: This is a dream lane: while Yuumi is unattached and walking up to poke with Prowling Projectile (Q), she is a soft, immobile 500-HP target. Reach level 2 first and Rocket Grab (Q) her out of position; her only safety is attaching to her ADC, so punish every second she's detached.

edits.before: Poke you down with You and Me! (Q) from safety while attached
edits.after: Poke you down with Prowling Projectile (Q) from safety while attached

edits.before: Kite the lane with Zoomies (W) shields and sustain, avoiding all-ins
edits.after: Kite the lane with Zoomies (E) shields and sustain, avoiding all-ins

edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mercs-Steelcaps by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.before: Commit on You and Me! (Attach)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on You and Me! (Attach)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: - Yuumi You and Me! (Attach): matchup-defining — Untargetable while attached — kill the host or catch the dismount windows. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Overdrive banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Yuumi You and Me! (W): 0-second cooldown — she can re-attach instantly, so track her attachment state, not a timer. - Keep Overdrive banked for their best play. - Your R silence denies her Final Chapter cast outright.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Yuumi has zero hard CC of her own — a landed Grab is uninterruptible unless she's mid-dash onto her ally.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Standing in her Prowling Projectile range between hooks lets her chip you down for free while your engage sits on cooldown.

notes: Two mislabeled abilities found: You and Me! (her W, 0-cd attach/dash) was written onto the Q slot in spikes[0].text and wants.foe[1] — real Q is Prowling Projectile. Zoomies (her actual E) was labeled W in wants.foe[2]. Fixed all three against enemyKit.
